title: Google Contacts
author: Atlas core
description: Use a Google address book from a process: find a contact by e-mail address, phone number or a custom field such as a customer number, read, list, create, update or delete contacts, put a label such as Kunden on one or take it off, and search the organization's Workspace directory. A model names the Worker and the operation; the credential — a service account acting as a Workspace user through domain-wide delegation, or a refresh token — lives in the vault and reaches only the worker (ADR-0476). A contact is one flat object: email, phone, organization, address, birthday, notes, fields (the custom fields by name) and groups (the labels). Find reads the address book itself and compares exactly, so a process deciding whether a customer is known is not misled by Google's search cache. A missing contact carries the code GOOGLECONTACTS_CONTACT_NOT_FOUND and is thrown as a BPMN error when the process catches it.

properties.label: Worker
properties.description: Name of the configured Google Contacts Worker (Console → Workers) whose address book the task uses, never a credential. The attribute behind this field is spelled connector like its siblings'.

choices.name: Find contacts (e-mail, phone or custom field)

properties.label: Contact (read, update, delete, labels)
properties.description: The contact by the id a read, a find or a create answered with (people/c…), e.g. =kunde.id.

properties.label: Query (find, search, directory)
properties.description: Find: an e-mail address or a phone number, compared exactly — or a custom field's value. Search and directory: a prefix Google matches against names, e-mail addresses, phone numbers and organizations; Google's search can lag behind recent changes, so decide whether a customer exists with Find.

properties.label: Custom field (find)
properties.description: Optional. Compare the query with this custom field, e.g. Kundennummer, instead of with the e-mail addresses and phone numbers.

properties.label: Label (labels; optional on find and list)
properties.description: A label by the name Google Contacts shows, e.g. Kunden. It must exist; a misspelt name is refused rather than created.

properties.label: Contact values (create, update)
properties.description: A JSON object with givenName, familyName, email, emails, phone, phones, organization, jobTitle, department, address, addresses, birthday, notes, fields and — on create — groups. A string starting with = is a FEEL expression. null changes nothing, "" clears; email, phone and address change the primary entry, emails, phones and addresses replace the list.

properties.label: Contact variable (create, update)
properties.description: Instead of the values above: a process variable holding the contact object.

properties.label: Maximum results (find, search, list, directory)
properties.description: Find and list fail above it rather than return a short list (defaults 100 and 500); the two searches return their best matches up to it (default 10; at most 30 for contacts, 500 for the directory).

properties.label: Result variable
properties.description: Receives the contact or the list of contacts. Delete and the two label operations return nothing, and the compiler refuses a result variable on them.
